evaluation.ranking: full catalogue: every candidate item (positive before cutoff) is scored; items the user rated before the cutoff are excluded
evaluation.metrics: Recall@K = hits/|targets|; NDCG@K binary gains; MRR over full ranking

two_tower.selection: val recall@50 (screening), early stopping on val recall@50 (full run)

popularity_bias.definition: head = top 1% of candidate items by positives before test_start (355 items); popularity percentile 1.0 = most popular
